sources.cx: function cx() { var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) { if (arguments[i]) out.push(arguments[i]); } return out.join(' '); }
sources.omit: function omit(o, keys) { var r = {}; for (var k in o) { if (keys.indexOf(k) < 0) r[k] = o[k]; } return r; }
sources.useId: function useId(given, prefix) { var r = R.useRef(null); if (!r.current) r.current = given || ('mds-' + prefix + '-' + (++uid)); return r.current; }
sources.sameDay: function sameDay(a, b) { return a && b && a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate(); }
sources.portal: function portal(node) { return window.ReactDOM && ReactDOM.createPortal && document.body ? ReactDOM.createPortal(node, document.body) : node; }
